an10.87:1.1: tatra kho bhagavā kāḷakabhikkhuṃ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi
an10.87:2.1: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu adhikaraṇiko hoti adhikaraṇasamathassa na vaṇṇavādī
an10.87:2.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu adhikaraṇiko hoti adhikaraṇasamathassa na vaṇṇavādī ayampi dhammo na piyatāya na garutāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu na sikkhākāmo hoti sikkhāsamādānassa na vaṇṇavādī
an10.87:3.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu na sikkhākāmo hoti sikkhāsamādānassa na vaṇṇavādī ayampi dhammo na piyatāya na garutāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu pāpiccho hoti icchāvinayassa na vaṇṇavādī
an10.87:4.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu pāpiccho hoti icchāvinayassa na vaṇṇavādī ayampi dhammo na piyatāya na garutāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.

an10.87:5.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhavinayassa na vaṇṇavādī ayampi dhammo na piyatāya na garutāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.

an10.87:6.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu makkhī hoti makkhavinayassa na vaṇṇavādī ayampi dhammo na piyatāya na garutāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.

an10.87:9.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammānaṃ na nisāmakajātiko hoti dhammanisantiyā na vaṇṇavādī ayampi dhammo na piyatāya na garutāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.

an10.87:10.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu na paṭisallāno hoti paṭisallānassa na vaṇṇavādī ayampi dhammo na piyatāya na garutāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:11.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ na paṭisanthārako hoti paṭisanthārakassa na vaṇṇavādī
an10.87:11.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ na paṭisanthārako hoti paṭisanthārakassa na vaṇṇavādī ayampi dhammo na piyatāya na garutāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:12.1: evarūpassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
an10.87:12.2: aho vata maṃ sabrahmacārī sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyunti athakho naṃ sabrahmacārī neva sakkaronti na garukaronti na mānenti na pūjenti
an10.87:12.4: tathāhissa bhikkhave viññū sabrahmacārī te pāpake akusale dhamme appahīne samanupassanti
an10.87:13.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave assamūḷhakassa kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
an10.87:13.2: aho vata maṃ manussā ājānīyaṭṭhāne ca ṭhapeyyuṃ ājānīyabhojanañca bhojeyyuṃ ājānīyaparimajjanañca parimajjeyyunti athakho taṃ manussā na ceva ājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapenti na ca ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojenti na ca ājānīyaparimajjanaṃ parimajjanti
an10.87:13.4: tathāhissa bhikkhave viññū manussā tāni sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni appahīnāni samanupassanti
an10.87:13.5: evameva kho bhikkhave evarūpassa bhikkhuno kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
an10.87:13.6: aho vata maṃ sabrahmacārī sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyunti athakho naṃ sabrahmacārī neva sakkaronti na garukaronti na mānenti na pūjenti
an10.87:13.8: tathāhissa bhikkhave viññū sabrahmacārī te pāpake akusale dhamme appahīne samanupassanti.
